parole.significato: A type of geological depression formed by the subsidence of permafrost, sometimes (partially) filled by a lake.
A triclinic-pedial mineral containing barium, calcium, fluorine, hydrogen, magnesium, oxygen, potassium, silicon, sodiu…
parole.testo: Named for type locality, from Yakut [script needed] (inneli), the Inagli river in Yakutia, Russia, + -ite.

parole.significato: a pillar-like rock formation resembling tall monoliths.
